title: Monitor and Check Data Model
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Monitor and Check Data Model.
learning_objectives: Explain monitor and check data model using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for monitor and check data model
Assess failure and operational limits of monitor and check data model
concepts_covered: A monitor is a saved URL/config; a check is one timestamped observation.
SQLite schema separates monitors and check history.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
